text:
Nikolaj Ehlers is out of Carolina's lineup for now, ruled out of the games against the Rangers and Tampa Bay, which is a shame for a player who was rolling. He'd put together a five-game point streak and 12 points in his last ten games before the injury, and has 22 points in 23 games overall, 11 of them on the power play.

The fit in Carolina, his second season after a decade in Winnipeg and a Cup last spring, still looks right. The Hurricanes take 59% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on at five on five. His own finishing is level with his chances (6 goals on 6.4 expected), though his teammates have run about 4.6 goals hot with him out there, and his points rate sits just above the top of our talent range.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 97th percentile in shot assists last season, carrying the puck in on 61% of his entries. The thing to watch is simple: when he's back, and whether the power-play role is waiting.
headline: Ehlers was rolling when the injury hit
